Now we have result: a single precursor: "O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21". This is a nitro-phenoxy-cyclohexanone? Good.

Now final template 74054 to apply to this precursor (and maybe also to other fragments like BrBr and Boc-protected piperazine). The order of templates must be exactly as given: 20810, 2895, 1914397, 1914398, 1914399, 74054. So after 1914399 we apply 74054 to the product of 1914399? Or to the whole set of fragments? Typically each template is applied to the molecule from previous step. The last template likely disconnects the remaining complex fragment into simple building blocks (maybe a carbonyl and phenol). Let's apply 74054 to the precursor "O=C1CC2(CCC2)Oc2ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc21".
